messages:
mia: Team idea 00: informal 'Bowling & Bites' after-work on Wed? mini-lanes + small plates from the food truck outside. :bowling: :taco:
jon: love it. after-work is perfect. what time were you thinking? 6pm?
priya: 6pm works. can we reserve 6:15-8:00 so folks can wrap up?
mark: i'm in if there's vegetarian options — and can someone check if the lanes are walkable from HQ?
taylor: food truck does veg tacos and sides. i can confirm menu. also might be able to get the lanes discounted for a group.
mia: cool. i'll ask for a group rate. quick poll: want to do casual teams for 5 frames? react with :one: for teams, :two: for free-play (no teams).
jon: :one:
priya: :one: (mini tournament sounds fun)
mark: :two: (i'm terrible at bowling, just want snacks)
taylor: i'll try to get 15% off with the vendor if we confirm headcount by Monday.
facilities: @mia we need a headcount by Mon to sign off on street permit for the food truck. max 40 people.
dev-calendar-bot: Event created: "Bowling & Bites (After-work)"  Wed Jul 10 18:15-20:00  RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.example/e/bowling-bites-223456
```
Invite: Bowling & Bites (After-work)
When: Wed Jul 10, 18:15-20:00
Where: Lanes & Local Food Truck (200m from HQ)
Notes: Bring ID for lanes. Label any dietary restrictions in the RSVP. Max 40 people. Please sign up for rideshares if you need one.
```
priya: i'll add a dietary column to the RSVP sheet. can someone volunteer to manage the lane signups (who bowls which frames)?
jon: i can do lane signups and organize teams. happy to take it.
mia: thanks jon. i'll post the RSVP link and ping everyone Friday. who wants to carpool from the office? react with :car: if yes.
mark: :car: (count me in)
taylor: i'll confirm vendor menu and post options by tomorrow.
mia: perfect. thanks everyone  this will be low-key and silly. see you there! :confetti_ball:
